# Finite mean-count endpoint calculations

These expanded fractions belong to Definition Y.11.7j.2 and the U34 source before the later joined family/count intervention of Theorem Y.8a. The complete physical source, raw CP endpoint fractions, detector-error allocation, photon calibration and proof remain in [the owning construction](../../../appendices/appendix_y_baryon_asymmetry.md). They use one common physical clock, volume and source word.

Write $[L_{\rm new},U_{\rm new}]$ for the raw CP interval, $E_B$ for the exact total baryon-detector error, $d_{\rm raw}$ for the positive rational labeled D or Raw margin, and $[I_{Y,\rm lo},I_{Y,\rm hi}]$ for the positive photon interval. The table entries below are the exact evaluated forms of
$$
B_{\rm lo}=3L_{\rm new}-E_B,\qquad B_{\rm hi}=3U_{\rm new}+E_B,
$$
$$
\eta_{\rm lo}=B_{\rm lo}/I_{Y,\rm hi},\qquad
\eta_{\rm hi}=B_{\rm hi}/I_{Y,\rm lo},
$$
and the componentwise quotients of these endpoints and the raw CP endpoints by $d_{\rm raw}$. All fractions retain their exact integer numerators and denominators.
